source.title: M.B.F.D. FIRE BOAT ALS INVENTORY
notes: Transcribed from the one-page PDF fire_boat_6_medical_inventory.pdf (sha256 above). Three printed columns of the same four-part table (ITEM, AMOUNT, Fill if <, NEED), read left to right and top to bottom. The page is larger than letter (1176.9 x 1523.1 points).

Left column: MEDS RED BAG, I.V./NEEDLES (red bands) and AIRWAY GREEN BAG (OPA and NPA). Middle column: AIRWAY, AIRWAY GREEN BAG (BVMs, i-gel, ET tubes, suction, blades), TRAUMA #1 BOX. Right column: TRAUMA #1 BOX ( CONT ), TRAUMA #2 BOX, MISCELLANEOUS ON BOAT, LIFE PACK INVENTORY.

The two printed AIRWAY GREEN BAG headings (left column, middle column) are kept as two sections. TRAUMA #1 BOX ( CONT ) is merged into TRAUMA #1 BOX. Blank table rows between sections carry nothing and are not items.

color_band records a color that the sheet prints in a heading (Meds Red Bag: Red; Airway Green Bag: Green) and the same colored band on I.V./NEEDLES (red) and AIRWAY (green). The TRAUMA boxes, MISCELLANEOUS ON BOAT and LIFE PACK INVENTORY bands are colored (amber, blue, light green) but name no color, so they carry no color_band.

AMOUNT is the par (min_text / min_qty / min_unit). "Fill if <" is flags.fill_if_text / fill_if_qty. NEED is blank on the sheet and is what the member enters. The boat's numbers are not the non-transport numbers (for example Quick-trach, N. Saline 1000cc, Tourniquet CAT 6, 1" tape 2) and are kept as printed.

Rows that say FIREBOAT 6 (portable suction with container, cardboard splints short and long) carry that text as qualifier_text. The five yellow "(1) PLACED IN BVM BAG" rows have location_text "Placed in BVM bag" and no AMOUNT (the sheet prints "1 in bag" under Fill if <).
This list holds only what the boat ALS sheet prints. Boat machinery, electronics, SCBA and fire gear belong to the Fire Boat 6 daily apparatus checkout, not here.
A row that lists several variants ("Auto BP Cuffs XL, L, REG,, PEDI, INFANT") is one item per printed variant with the row's AMOUNT.
source.printed_header: Date: / / M.B.F.D. FIRE BOAT ALS INVENTORY Unit# FB# 4 & 5 Revised 7-2025
review_notes: The header prints "Unit# FB# 4 & 5" but the item rows say "FIREBOAT 6" ("Portable suction with container (FIREBOAT 6)", "Cardboard splints short (FIREBOAT 6)", "Cardboard splints long (FIREBOAT 6)"). This list is Fire Boat 6's (key fire-boat-6-als); the header text is kept verbatim in printed_header and no data was changed. A person should confirm the sheet is Fire Boat 6's and fix the printed header on the next revision.
Five yellow BVM bag rows (ET Tube extention, BVM CO Capnoline, i-gel 5, i-gel 4, i-gel 3) print no AMOUNT and "1 in bag" under "Fill if <". Recorded as printed (no par); flagged for review.

"Adult Manual BP Cuff" and "Pedi Manual BP Cuff" sit under I.V./NEEDLES (between Nasal MADDET and Convenience bags) and "Safety Glasses (Clear)" is the first row of I.V./NEEDLES. Kept in that section by position.
